intro_same: Practice: the same Monsoon Mart review, with fewer hints and harder questions. Link the repository, the scanners and the audit trail yourself.

ask: How many files in repo/ sit inside a hidden folder (one whose name starts with a dot)?
On which date was the cloud key removed from the code? (YYYY-MM-DD)
How many days after that was the key used from outside?
Which PyYAML version fixes the critical advisory?
How many of the failed Checkov checks are on the orders database?
Which Checkov check ID is SSH open to the world?
How many seconds apart were the RunInstances calls?
Which action at 21:49 would keep the attacker in after the leaked key is revoked?
Which invoice did the attacker download? (file name)
How many findings in the register are known to be exploited?
